previous_record_scope: The first refresh and its image, source hashes and test receipts remain historical evidence, not receipts for this later environment.

patch_encoding_equivalence.scope: After execution, unified-diff context encoding was shortened to avoid literal context-marker whitespace diagnostics. The current patch applies with fuzz0; every patched source file matches the actual compiled and qualified builder byte-for-byte. No runtime code, binary or image changed; compiler warnings and Git whitespace checks remain enabled.

implemented: Install signed official trixie-backports curl8.21.0 packages, fixing CVE-2026-8458 without rebuilding curl or importing an unstable core runtime.
Physically remove optional infocmp and Perl Archive::Tar module/wrappers, retaining package metadata and the Perl interpreter. Canaries require Perl to work and Archive::Tar loading to fail.

Build the nine originally installed util-linux family packages from signed Debian2.41.5-0+deb13u1 source with checksum-pinned upstream descriptor/mount hardening patches. Existing Debian patches are verified by exact reverse dry runs; new hunks require fuzz0.
Retain honest local +mve1 package versions, including Debian's special bsdutils/login epochs. No claim that these are official Debian fixes or the entire next upstream release.

Correct the backported RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS fallback to Linux ABI0x04 and include its defining header in hook_idmap.c. A real compiled-wrapper regression rejects ordinary symlinks; its wrong0x02 negative control fails.
Strengthen actual candidate and evaluator identity/authority canaries without broadening permissions, capabilities, network access or filesystem mounts.

advisory_dispositions.CVE-2025-69720: Affected infocmp executable removed and absence checked. This does not clear other ncurses parser/library findings.
advisory_dispositions.CVE-2026-9538: Archive::Tar code and entry points removed; actual module-load rejection checked. Other Perl advisories remain unresolved.
advisory_dispositions.CVE-2026-8458: Fixed by the installed8.21.0 curl backport; actual loaded GnuTLS libcurl version recorded. This does not clear advisories affecting8.21.0.
advisory_dispositions.util_linux: Pinned upstream hardening series installed and real wrapper checked. Keep raw source-package matches; CVE-2026-78409 version/feature applicability remains explicitly uncleared rather than silently copying an earlier-version conclusion.
advisory_dispositions.CVE-2026-54369: libacl library remains unpatched. The actual unprivileged child cannot alter a protected read-only target through a symlink; candidate/evaluator UID1001, capabilities0 and NNP1 are checked. No privileged libacl caller was identified in the fixed supervisor path. This is scoped caller mitigation, not a library fix or owner risk acceptance.
advisory_dispositions.CVE-2026-16742: Affected systemd-homed service is not installed; source-package matches on libsystemd/libudev do not provide that service.
advisory_dispositions.CVE-2026-12064: Upstream limits this issue to the curl CLI, which is not installed, not the matched libcurl library.
advisory_dispositions.remaining_lower_and_unknown: Bounded triage found additional curl, Perl regex, ncurses parser, Expat, Pod::Text, glibc loader, dash and tar issues requiring separate fixes or exact applicability evidence. No blanket dismissal based on isolation, UID or absent network access.

scan.scanner: Trivy0.76.1 with the retained2026-10-30 database; exported image scanned locally, no source/image upload and no suppressions.
scan.interpretation: Raw counts repeat IDs across installed packages, including removed or locally patched code whose metadata is deliberately retained. They are not an exploit count or a clean scan. Larger counts than the first refresh are not suppressed.

image_identity.explanation: Docker's OCI index ID and Trivy's configuration ID differ by design; exact exported blobs bind them. The provisional-image identity concern was resolved by the same verification, not by assuming equal identifiers.

offline_validation.reference_result: All11stages with three exact agreeing expected all-pass contract vectors. No snapshot writeback or provider calls; stop-on-discrepancy policy retained.

upstream_package_qualification.existing_exclusions: The unchanged suite retains root/device/hardware/Docker skips and five known-failing subcases. This does not mean337fully executed, unconditionally passing tests. The setarch Docker exclusion was detected naturally.

offline_validation.scope: These actual source-bound diagnostics precede this evidence/readiness metadata addition. They are not study observations, independent human acceptance, residual-risk acceptance or a replacement freeze. Final-source canaries must be renewed after metadata settles.

preserved_diagnostics: The first root package build skipped nonroot upstream checks and was not treated as sufficient qualification.

The nonroot BuildKit build exposed a setarch personality-denial failure. Stock distribution setarch has the same denial; unchanged upstream tests explicitly detect/skip unsupported Docker execution. Ordinary Docker qualification uses natural environment detection, not modified tests or expanded permissions.

An accidentally offline qualification-image build could not fetch public build dependencies. Rebuilt with ordinary dependency-download access; actual nonroot qualification and candidate/evaluator execution remain network-isolated.

The first wrapper fixture had a duplicate _GNU_SOURCE definition; fixed the fixture instead of disabling compiler warnings. Both the positive test and deliberate incorrect-flag negative control were retained.

A shortened diff context initially failed exact application; corrected its encoding without changing source. The byte-equivalence diagnostic initially tried reading root-owned patch text as the unprivileged qualifier; it now passes the non-sensitive file list from source preparation instead. No user or permission was elevated.

next_blocker.signed_binary_compatibility_probe: Official sid8.23.0-1 packages require libc6>=2.43 and libngtcp2>=1.24.0; this Debian13 runtime has2.41 and1.22.1. Stable/backports-only apt simulation correctly refused them. No dependency was forced or replaced.
next_blocker.decision_needed: Source-backport newer curl against the existing runtime versus a broader core-runtime migration versus waiting for a compatible maintained package. No unstable libc upgrade or residual-risk acceptance inferred.

Historical approvals, protocol-frozen-v2, original registered assets and accounting ledgers remain unchanged. Current runtime/final-source acceptance is still pending.
